categories.title: Developing Mathematical Models for Complex Polymeric Systems
categories.description: We develop coarse-grained simulation models and computational methods to study the self-assembly, thermodynamics, and dynamics of complex polymeric systems at the mesoscale.

topics.title: Coarse-grained Model of Bottlebrushes
topics.description: Development of coarse-grained models for bottlebrush polymers to study their single-chain properties and self-assembly behavior, enabling efficient simulation of these complex architectures.

topics.title: Morphological Diversity in Graft-Linear Block Copolymer (BCPs)
topics.description: Investigation of the rich morphological phase space in graft-linear block copolymers, exploring how molecular architecture influences self-assembled structures.

topics.title: Mesoscale Simulation Model for Solution Assembly
topics.description: Building mesoscale simulation frameworks to capture the solution-phase assembly of polymeric systems, bridging the gap between atomistic and continuum approaches.

topics.title: Solution Assembly of Amphiphilic Grafting Polymer
topics.description: Studying how amphiphilic graft polymers organize in solution to form micelles, vesicles, and other nanostructures through simulation and theory.

topics.title: Modeling of EUV Photoresist & Patterning Process
topics.description: Computational modeling of extreme ultraviolet (EUV) photoresist materials and the patterning process for next-generation semiconductor lithography.

topics.title: High-resolution Patterning Combined with EUV and DSA
topics.description: Integrating EUV lithography with directed self-assembly (DSA) of block copolymers to achieve sub-10nm patterning for advanced semiconductor manufacturing.

topics.title: Dielectric Spectroscopy of Low Permittivity Polymers
topics.description: Computational investigation of dielectric properties of low-permittivity polymers, correlating molecular structure with macroscopic dielectric response.

topics.title: Infiltration of Biopolymers into Mesoporous Particles
topics.description: Modeling the infiltration and confinement of biopolymers within mesoporous particles, exploring confinement effects on polymer behavior.

topics.title: Solvent Vapor Annealing
topics.description: Simulation studies of solvent vapor annealing processes for block copolymer thin films, understanding how solvent-polymer interactions drive ordering kinetics.

topics.title: Nanoscale Organic Lattices with Strongly-Correlated Disorder
topics.description: Exploring the physics of nanoscale organic lattices that exhibit strongly-correlated disorder, bridging condensed matter physics and polymer science.

categories.title: Materials/Systems Design through Data Science and Machine Learning
categories.description: We leverage artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data-driven approaches to accelerate the design of novel polymer materials and predict system behavior.

topics.title: Defect Detection and Classification
topics.description: Application of machine learning and computer vision techniques for automated detection and classification of defects in polymer thin films and patterned structures.

topics.title: HAPPY (HierArchically Abstracted rePeat unit of PolYmer) - Novel String Representation
topics.description: Development of HAPPY, a novel hierarchical string representation for polymers that enables efficient machine learning on polymer datasets by encoding structural information.

topics.title: Battery State-of-Health (SOH) Prediction
topics.description: Using machine learning models to predict battery state-of-health from electrochemical data, enabling better battery management and lifecycle prediction.

topics.title: Molecular Dynamic Simulations Combined with Machine Learning
topics.description: Combining molecular dynamics simulations with machine learning to develop surrogate models and accelerate the exploration of materials design spaces.

categories.title: Non-simple Boundary and Its Effects on Self-assembly
categories.description: We investigate how complex boundaries and confinement geometries influence the self-assembly of block copolymers and other soft matter systems.

topics.title: Emulsified BCP Droplets
topics.description: Studying the self-assembly of block copolymers within emulsified droplets, where spherical confinement leads to frustrated and novel morphologies.

topics.title: Boundary Directed Epitaxy
topics.description: Developing boundary-directed epitaxy as a novel approach to direct the self-assembly of block copolymers using lithographically defined chemical patterns.
